'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War on drugs]], [[Operation Southern Spear]]
**[[2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers]]
***The [[United States Southern Command]] says the [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] has carried out [[airstrike]]s on three alleged [[Illegal drug trade|drug smuggling]] vessels in [[international waters]] of the [[Pacific Ocean|Eastern Pacific]], killing at least eight people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-military-says-it-carried-out-strikes-three-vessels-eastern-pacific-2025-12-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Ten people are killed when a [[Cessna Citation III]] aircraft flying from [[Acapulco]] to [[Toluca]] crashes near a football field in [[San Mateo Atenco]], [[State of Mexico|Edomex]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.unotv.com/estados/estado-de-mexico/10-muertos-y-ningun-sobreviviente-tras-desplome-de-avioneta-en-edomex/ (UNO TV <small>in Spanish</small>)] [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-small-plane-crash-17177c5f418377f3984e145897779cdd/ (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Laos–South Korea relations]]
**[[Laos]] and [[South Korea]] agree to upgrade their bilateral relations to a [[comprehensive partnership]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-laos-upgrade-relations-comprehensive-partnership-seoul-says-2025-12-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[Laos–Thailand relations]], [[2025 Cambodia–Thailand conflict]]
**[[Thailand]]'s [[Royal Thai Armed Forces|military]] stops [[Energy in Thailand|fuel shipments]] through [[Laos–Thailand border|its border crossing with Laos]] in [[Chong Mek]], [[Ubon Ratchathani province]], after [[National Intelligence Agency (Thailand)|intelligence]] indicates that supplies are being diverted to [[Cambodia]]n [[Royal Cambodian Armed Forces|forces]] amid an ongoing conflict between Cambodia and Thailand. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/thailand-cuts-laos-fuel-route-cambodia-border-conflict-deepens-2025-12-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[Trinidad and Tobago–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Venezuela]]n government accuses [[Trinidad and Tobago]] of participating in the [[United States seizure of the oil tanker Skipper|United States seizure of the oil tanker ''Skipper'']] and suspends all oil trade agreements and contracts between the two countries. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/dec/15/trinidad-tobago-us-access-airports-venezuela-tensions-grow (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 anti-tourism protests in Spain]]
**The [[Spanish government]] fines [[homestay]] company [[Airbnb]] {{Euro}}63.9 million (US$75 million) for advertising unlicensed tourist rentals as protests blaming companies like Airbnb and [[Booking.com]] for driving up [[Real estate appraisal|property prices]] for residents across [[Spain|the country]] continue. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-airbnb-fine-overtourism-crackdown-fa2bdc048a63aa5632f2c59373b70b46 (AP)]
*[[Capital punishment in Saudi Arabia]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] records a new annual high in [[executions]], carrying out 340 executions to date after [[Politics of Saudi Arabia|authorities]] execute three additional individuals, exceeding the previous record of 338 executions in 2024. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/saudi-sets-new-death-penalty-record-after-executing-340-in-2025-afp-tally/ (AFP via CTV News)]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**Five individuals associated with the [[American Left|far-left]] [[Turtle Island]] Liberation Front are arrested for allegedly plotting a series of bombings across [[Southern California]], [[United States]], on [[New Year's Eve]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn41gqq8vyko (BBC News)]
*[[Hong Kong]]'s [[Hong Kong High Court|High Court]] convicts [[Pro-democracy camp (Hong Kong)|pro-democracy]] activist and media entrepreneur [[Jimmy Lai]] of conspiracy to [[Collusion|collude]] with foreign forces and to publish [[Sedition|seditious]] material under the [[2020 Hong Kong national security law|national security law]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/jimmy-lais-supporters-queue-hong-kong-overnight-verdict-2025-12-14/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Judiciary of Russia|court]] in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]], designates [[protest music]] group [[Pussy Riot]] as an [[List of organizations designated as terrorist or extremist by Russia|extremist group]], banning its activities within Russia. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/russian-anti-kremlin-punk-band-pussy-riot-designated-an-extremist-organisation-2025-12-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[Danske Bank]] completes its three-year corporate [[probation]] with the [[United States Department of Justice]], concluding all regulatory proceedings related to suspicious transactions at its former [[Estonia]]n branch, after pleading guilty to [[bank fraud]] [[conspiracy]] and forfeiting US$2 billion as part of a 2022 settlement. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/danske-bank-completes-us-probation-over-estonia-case-2025-12-15/ (Reuters)]
*A judge in the [[Dominican Republic]] sentences seven former [[Government of the Dominican Republic|government]] officials to over a year in [[preventative detention]] in a US$250 million [[corruption]] case involving the [[Ministries of the Dominican Republic|health ministry]]. [https://apnews.com/article/dominican-republic-corruption-prison-senasa-health-98684bdbd52acab38c0a3518f8b6e101 (AP)]
